canon.silhouette: lines and geometry - a flat-topped rectangle stack: horizontal shoulder line, axis-aligned rectangular tower shield, dead-vertical 2px banner pole
canon.reads_as: a walking rectangle under a pale flag - the one straight-edged figure in the crowd

prompt.description: A stocky armored standard-bearer in heavy plate. Oversized head in an open-faced helm with no visor and no crest, broad blunt face, squared pauldrons forming a flat horizontal shoulder line, short thick legs. One arm holds a large rectangular tower shield with a flat top edge and a single straight band across its middle; the other grips a straight vertical banner pole at the hip, topped by a small rectangular flag of plain undecorated cloth. A short sword stays sheathed at the hip. Boxy build, hard straight edges, everything squared off.
must_include: flat horizontal shoulder line, unbroken by collar or cloth
rectangular tower shield with a flat top edge and four straight sides
dead-vertical thin banner pole running down to a hand at hip height
small rectangular flag with four straight edges, clear of the head
open face visible under the helm, no visor
must_avoid: swallowtail, forked, torn or curving flag edges
any device, emblem or writing on the flag
helm crest, plume, wings or horns
lamp, torch, candle or visible flame
glow, halo, sparks or rays around any pixel
tassels, fringe, ragged cloth or straps hanging off the silhouette
